svg.title: Interface agents for an automated biomanufacturing DBTL pipeline
svg.desc: The four DBTL stages of the SYNBIOCHEM automated pipeline for microbial production of fine chemicals (Carbonell et al., Communications Biology 2018, Fig. 1), with four proposed interface agents handling the handoffs between stages, a coordination layer, and an exit to process development and scale-up.
svg.text: Interface agents for an automated biomanufacturing DBTL pipeline
Case study: (2S)-pinocembrin in E. coli · SYNBIOCHEM pipeline, Carbonell et al., Communications Biology (2018)

g.text: Select pathway, enzymes and parts library
Infer design rules from titer data
Expand DoE library into part lists
Register parts in ICE · emit worklists
Map plasmid IDs to wells and runs
Gate peaks by LOD / LOQ and calibration
Join titers to design factor table
Decide DoE vs full-factorial next round
Chassis and media screening, genome integration, scale-up

svg.text: Solid arrows: DBTL flow through interface agents · Dashed lines: coordination and oversight · Green: exit to scale-up
Proposed architecture · not implemented in the original study
